verdict: Las Vegas Sands earned $352M on $3.2B of revenue, down from $491M a year ago, as casino revenue fell 5% even though rooms, food and mall income all grew.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, attributable, vs $0.61 a year ago

segments.name: Casino
segments.note: Gaming win from tables and slots across Macao, Singapore and Las Vegas — still almost three-quarters of all revenue, down 5% from $2,506M a year ago.

segments.name: Rooms
segments.note: Hotel rooms at the integrated resorts.

segments.name: Mall
segments.note: Rent and sales from the luxury retail malls inside the resorts.

segments.name: Convention, retail & other
segments.note: Conventions, entertainment, retail and other resort income.

opex.name: Pre-opening
opex.note: Costs of preparing new or renovated properties to open.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of the resorts and equipment over their working lives.

opex.name: Amortization of leasehold land
opex.note: Amortization of leasehold interests in land.

opex.name: Loss on disposal / impairment
opex.note: Loss on disposal or impairment of assets.

takeaways.title: Casino softness drove the dip
takeaways.text: Casino revenue fell to $2,370M from $2,506M a year ago and total revenue slipped 3% to $3,216M, while every non-gaming line — rooms, food and beverage, mall and conventions — grew.

takeaways.title: Sands China profit fell 30%
takeaways.text: Sands China revenue rose 1.4% to $1.93B, but its net income dropped 29.8% to $191M from $272M, the main drag on the group result.

takeaways.title: What LVS shareholders kept
takeaways.text: Consolidated net income was $352M; after $48M attributable to noncontrolling interests (mainly Sands China's minority holders), $304M belonged to Las Vegas Sands shareholders, or $0.48 per diluted share.

oneTimers: Loss on disposal or impairment of assets was only $4M this quarter, versus $68M a year ago.
Net income includes $48M attributable to noncontrolling interests; net income attributable to Las Vegas Sands Corp. was $304M.
otherDetail: Net other expense of $164M: interest expense of $186M net of amounts capitalized, partly offset by $23M of interest income, plus $1M of other expense.
footerNote: Net income in the flow is consolidated net income of $352M, before the $48M attributable to noncontrolling interests; net income attributable to Las Vegas Sands Corp. was $304M. Resort operations play the role of cost of revenue, so gross profit is revenue less resort operations.
